{"agent":"plc-doctrine-consistency","action":"PLAN","category":"rule","critical":true,"file":".claude/plans/review-cadence-part-close.md:65","description":"The session-close dense pass seats sa-architecture-sweep over raw files, and E5 then seats it again as the holistic pass.","old":null,"new":null,"question":null,"options":["E5's dense step passes --mandates as the candidate set minus every interaction:\"scope\" mandate, and the E5 holistic row is the only thing that covers architecture-sweep at session close (Recommended)","uncovered drops scope mandates unless named explicitly, and the plan states that default in the review_ledger.py docstring"],"scope":[".claude/plans/review-cadence-part-close.md",".claude/commands/session_end.md",".claude/skills/_brainstorm_shared/execution_depth.md"],"rationale":"Read (rung 2). architecture-sweep is a candidate key: session_audit_agents.md:88 'mandates: architecture-sweep', and review_ledger.py:636 candidate_keys() is the mandates of the session_audit lenses. session_end.md:32 runs 'uncovered --files <the scope's files> --mandates candidate'. E5 keeps that step ('seating dense lenses on the printed pairs'), and no scope-hashed sweep row exists before E5's later holistic pass. So every scope file prints (f, architecture-sweep), and the dense /session_audit --files run seats the sweep over raw files. execution_depth.md:131 also admits it on 'design = open, reach ≥ shared'. E5 then runs '/session_audit --lens sa-architecture-sweep' again. This contradicts the plan's own Goal ('No work is reviewed twice'), P3 ('dense lenses only on ... the fast-path and unreviewed residue'), and D-c ('Rejected: raw diffs, which re-read what the unit reviews already covered')."},
{"agent":"plc-doctrine-consistency","action":"PLAN","category":"rule","critical":false,"file":".claude/plans/review-cadence-part-close.md:32","description":"The plan does not say whether a Part-close review seats the interaction mandate, and drive_spine §Close step 2 still requires it at every close.","old":null,"new":null,"question":null,"options":["Part close keeps the sweep: state it in P1, add its architect-tier cost to R3's 1.4x figure, and correct D-b ('part: rows cover local mandates'), because clause 8 is mandate-agnostic and a part: sweep row also covers session readers (Recommended if P2's 'that unit's own sweep covered it' is intended)","Part close drops the sweep: E6 rewrites drive_spine.md:118-119 so that a Part close's report needs no sa-architecture-sweep verdict, and P2's one-unit clause is restated"],"scope":[".claude/plans/review-cadence-part-close.md",".claude/skills/_brainstorm_shared/drive_spine.md"],"rationale":"Read (rung 2). drive_spine.md:118-119: 'run `/session_audit <base>..HEAD` and read its report. {"agent":"plc-doctrine-consistency","action":"PLAN","category":"improvement","critical":false,"file":".claude/plans/review-cadence-part-close.md:57","description":"The new `--scope <scope.json>` flag duplicates the existing `--scope-json <file>` input on `record` and `plan`.","old":null,"new":null,"question":null,"options":["Reuse `--scope-json`: record and plan already read `files` from it; compute scopeHash from the same file and add `--scope-json` to `uncovered` (Recommended)","Keep `--scope`, and retire `--scope-json` from record and plan in the same job"],"scope":[".claude/plans/review-cadence-part-close.md",".claude/tools/review_ledger.py"],"rationale":"Read (rung 2). review_ledger.py:1733 'record.add_argument(\"--scope-json\")' and :1716 'plan.add_argument(\"--scope-json\")'. :1520-1521 'if args.scope_json: files_in += [str(p) for p in _load_scope(args.scope_json).get(\"files\") or []]'. _load_scope (:504) accepts any JSON object with `files`, and close_predicates' {identity, commits, files, basis, error} is that shape. Adding a second flag for the same file on the same subcommands creates a second home that can drift: a caller that passes one flag and not the other gets files without a hash, or a hash without files. Inferred (rung 3): the parser sets no allow_abbrev=False, so argparse resolves `--scope` to `--scope-json` today, and the new flag silently changes what an existing `--scope` call means."},
{"agent":"plc-doctrine-consistency","action":"PLAN","category":"rule","critical":false,"file":".claude/plans/review-cadence-part-close.md:45","description":"Units come only from `part:` rows, and only the programme path records `part:`.
